nodes.label: click-3360 repo pinning (base_sha / start_sha)
nodes.rationale: base_sha 63274a79 is merge_commit^1, not the PR's recorded base.sha -- the base branch advanced from 7c99ebe to 63274a7 between the PR being opened and merged, and diffing against the stale one would put unrelated commits into the reference. start_sha 33575cc0 is base_sha plus the test half committed with a fixed identity and date, pinned so that a re-cut patch or a different git moving the start state is a load error rather than a silent change to what every arm was asked to do.

nodes.label: click-3360 verbatim issue prompt
nodes.rationale: Section 3.3: the issue title then the body exactly as filed, including the reporter's HTML template comment. Nothing added -- a harness-authored sentence would be a different task from the one a human actually opened. Subject: HelpFormatter.write_usage produces an empty Usage line when no args are passed.

nodes.label: click-3360 f2p test set
nodes.rationale: Measured, not guessed: exactly the tests that fail at the start state and pass after the reference fix. They assert rendered output rather than any internal name, so a different-but-correct fix passes -- which is why this PR was chosen over #3678, whose tests pin an arbitrary storage name. p2p is deliberately empty (everything else the runner collects, 1,615 tests at this base_sha, green before and after); an explicit list would go stale against a pinned suite for no benefit. The runner passes `-p no:cacheprovider` so the suite writes no .pytest_cache into the tree, because section 5.6 stages everything.

nodes.label: click-3360 allow_extra_paths (CHANGES.rst)
nodes.rationale: Files in the merged PR that belong to NEITHER half. The changelog entry cites :issue:`3360` :pr:`3434` -- no agent will write that, so leaving it in the solution half makes preflight apply documentation it does not need and would make any later diff-similarity metric measure changelog authorship. Explicit rather than inferred: nothing available at load time can tell a changelog from a source file, so an UNLISTED extra file still lands in the fix half exactly as before.

nodes.label: click-3360 image block (less, pytest 8.3.5, editable install)
nodes.rationale: apt: less because it is a TEST dependency and the base image ships no pager -- test_echo_via_pager parametrizes over ['cat','less',...] and with no less on PATH the pager path closes the borrowed stdout, so pytest's capfd raises 'I/O operation on closed file' in setup AND teardown of every remaining test in the file: 189 errors, none about the code under test, and it does not reproduce on macOS. pip: pytest==8.3.5 because the base image pins pytest 9.1.1 and click sets filterwarnings=['error'], so pytest 9 raises PytestRemovedIn10Warning during collection and the suite exits 2 -- red before AND after any fix; upstream fixed it in #3656, two months after this base_sha. build must be EDITABLE: a plain `pip install .` resolves imports to site-packages so nothing the agent writes to /repo takes effect and every arm fails identically.

nodes.label: click-3360 budget placeholders
nodes.rationale: max_turns 40 / wall_clock_timeout_s 900 are section 5.4 placeholders. Real caps come from the section 3.5 calibration pilot's slowest-converging model, not from the incumbent.

nodes.label: click-3360 provenance (Tier B)
nodes.rationale: Tier B (section 3.2): a tested PR with no transcript -- the oracle is executable and the merged PR is the reference diff. pallets/click issue 3360, PR 3434, merge_commit 3bb230dc, merged 2026-05-16, BSD-3-Clause. session_id and original_model are explicitly null rather than omitted, because no transcript exists for this work.
